name: jaeger_collector_slow_span_persistence
title: Jaeger collector slow span persistence
description: Jaeger collector has a p99 span persistence latency, indicating the storage backend is slow to accept span writes.

source.upstream_query: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, instance, job, namespace) (rate(jaeger_collector_save_latency_bucket[5m]))) > 0.5
source.upstream_description: Jaeger collector on {{ $labels.instance }} has a p99 span persistence latency of {{ $value }}s, indicating the storage backend is slow to accept span writes.

query_condition.promql: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, instance, job, namespace) (rate(jaeger_collector_save_latency_bucket[5m])))

notes: 0.5s threshold is a rough default; write latency depends on your storage backend and span ingestion volume — adjust based on your baseline.
